metadata.limitations: No beta/EC feeding, E0 edges, conversion competition, excitation cross sections, timing cuts, or inferred missing branches. Excited gamma terminals are not necessarily stable.
metadata.probability_semantics: Positive non-E0 relative gamma intensity / outgoing sum; conditional gamma branching, not Coulomb-excitation populations or absolute photon yields
metadata.selection: All absolute-energy levels at or below upper state; not only descendants of upper state
